changes.detail: With trustedProxies set and no x-forwarded-for, the IP key fell back to cf-connecting-ip, fly-client-ip, true-client-ip or x-real-ip, which any client can send, so a caller could choose its own rate-limit key. Those headers are no longer read unless one is named as clientIpHeader. trustedProxyCidrs (also on the Elysia plugin) limits forwarded-header trust to connections from the proxies themselves; ipInCidr is exported.
changes.summary: Stop trusting CDN client headers by default; add trustedProxyCidrs and clientIpHeader
Add driver-independent PostgreSQL atomic rate-limit storage for host transaction clients
